examples.text_en: Farmers distill the fruit to make strong drink.
examples.text_zh: 农民把水果蒸馏成烈酒。

examples.text_en: They distill sea water into clean drinking water.
examples.text_zh: 他们把海水蒸馏成干净的饮用水。

examples.text_en: The distillation of the water can take time.
examples.text_zh: 水的蒸馏需要时间。

examples.text_en: They study the distillation of gold in class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在课上学习黄金的蒸馏。

examples.text_en: The room was distinctively decorated in warm colors.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间以暖色调装饰，别具一格。

examples.text_en: She writes in a distinctively clear and simple style.
examples.text_zh: 她的写作风格清晰简洁，别具特色。

examples.text_en: I remember that day distinctly and quite well.
examples.text_zh: 那一天我至今记得清清楚楚。

examples.text_en: Her voice was distinctly different from his.
examples.text_zh: 她的嗓音和他的明显不同。

examples.text_en: He is a distinguished doctor and a kind man.
examples.text_zh: 他是一位杰出的医生，也是个善良的人。

examples.text_en: She came from a distinguished local family.
examples.text_zh: 她出身于一个显赫的本地家族。

examples.text_en: The mirror seemed to distort her thin face.
examples.text_zh: 镜子似乎把她的脸拉得变了形。

examples.text_en: Loud music can distort the sound of a voice.
examples.text_zh: 响亮的音乐会使人的声音失真。

examples.text_en: The paper map showed a clear distortion.
examples.text_zh: 这张纸质地图显示出明显的变形。

examples.text_en: We must correct the distortion in these figures.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须纠正这些数据中的失真。

examples.text_en: The strong sound was a distraction for the class.
examples.text_zh: 巨大的声响对全班来说是一种干扰。

examples.text_en: A good film is a fine distraction after work.
examples.text_zh: 一部好电影是下班后不错的消遣。

examples.text_en: The distrait man did not hear my words.
examples.text_zh: 这个心不在焉的人没听见我的话。

examples.text_en: She was distrait and lost her own way.
examples.text_zh: 她心不在焉，连路都走错了。

examples.text_en: The distraught woman could not find her son.
examples.text_zh: 这位心烦意乱的母亲找不到自己的儿子。

examples.text_en: He was distraught after the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 听到坏消息后他心烦意乱。

examples.text_en: A small disturbance woke the baby at night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里一点小动静把婴儿吵醒了。

examples.text_en: The noise caused a disturbance in the quiet street.
examples.text_zh: 那阵喧闹在这条安静的街上引起了骚动。

examples.text_en: Such a quarrel could disunite the small team.
examples.text_zh: 这样的争吵会使这个小团队分裂。

examples.text_en: Fear and lies may disunite a strong nation.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧和谎言可能使一个强大的民族分裂。

examples.text_en: They play a small ditty on the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们在路上演奏一支小曲。

examples.text_en: The ditty was short and very fine.
examples.text_zh: 这支小调短小而十分动听。

examples.text_en: The diurnal change in the light was clear.
examples.text_zh: 光线的昼夜变化十分明显。

examples.text_en: They study the diurnal life of the area.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究这片区域昼间的生命活动。

examples.text_en: The diva will play a long song that night.
examples.text_zh: 那位歌剧女主角那晚将演奏一首长曲。

examples.text_en: They call her a diva in the world of music.
examples.text_zh: 音乐界的人都称她为首席女歌手。

examples.text_en: Try not to divagate when you tell the story.
examples.text_zh: 讲故事时尽量不要跑题。

examples.text_en: He began to divagate about his early travels.
examples.text_zh: 他开始东拉西扯地讲起早年的旅行。

examples.text_en: The diver will go down into the dark water.
examples.text_zh: 潜水者将潜入那片昏暗的水中。

examples.text_en: A good diver can find the gold under the sea.
examples.text_zh: 技术好的潜水者能在海下找到黄金。

examples.text_en: The two groups diverge on this hard question.
examples.text_zh: 这两个群体在这个难题上产生了分歧。

examples.text_en: Their work will diverge at the end of the year.
examples.text_zh: 他们的工作在年末将出现分歧。

examples.text_en: There was a divergence between the two groups.
examples.text_zh: 这两个群体之间出现了分歧。

examples.text_en: The divergence of the two areas was clear.
examples.text_zh: 这两个区域之间的差异很明显。

examples.text_en: They come from divergent areas of the world.
examples.text_zh: 他们来自世界上截然不同的地区。

examples.text_en: Their divergent work was hard to put together.
examples.text_zh: 他们分歧各异的工作很难整合到一起。

examples.text_en: The diversification of the work was a good move.
examples.text_zh: 让工作多样化是个好举措。

examples.text_en: They talk about the diversification of the company.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论公司的多元化。

examples.text_en: The company has a diversified group of people.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司的人员构成很多样。

examples.text_en: Their work is diversified and full of change.
examples.text_zh: 他们的工作多种多样，充满变化。

examples.text_en: They will diversify the work of the company.
examples.text_zh: 他们会让公司的工作更加多样化。

examples.text_en: We must diversify our food and our art.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须让饮食和艺术都多样化。

examples.text_en: The diversion of the water was a big job.
examples.text_zh: 引开这些水是项大工程。

examples.text_en: A good book is a fine diversion for him.
examples.text_zh: 一本好书对他来说是不错的消遣。

examples.text_en: The diversity of the group was a good thing.
examples.text_zh: 这个群体的多样性是件好事。

examples.text_en: We value the diversity of life in this area.
examples.text_zh: 我们珍视这一带生命的多样性。

examples.text_en: They had to divert the traffic around the crash.
examples.text_zh: 他们不得不让车辆绕开事故现场。

examples.text_en: A funny story can divert a worried child.
examples.text_zh: 一个有趣的故事能让担心的孩子开心起来。

examples.text_en: He chose to divest himself of those duties.
examples.text_zh: 他选择卸下那些职责。

examples.text_en: The firm will divest its smaller local shops.
examples.text_zh: 公司将剥离较小的本地门店。

examples.text_en: The divestiture of that unit surprised the staff.
examples.text_zh: 那个部门的剥离让员工们感到意外。

examples.text_en: They announced a quiet divestiture last week.
examples.text_zh: 他们上周宣布了一次低调的资产剥离。

examples.text_en: The dividend of the company was very small.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司的股利非常少。

examples.text_en: Each person will get a part of the dividend.
examples.text_zh: 每个人都会分得一部分股利。

examples.text_en: She refused to divulge the name of her friend.
examples.text_zh: 她拒绝透露她朋友的名字。

examples.text_en: He must not divulge these secret company plans.
examples.text_zh: 他绝不能泄露这些公司机密计划。

examples.text_en: The dizziness can make it hard to walk.
examples.text_zh: 头昏眼花会让人难以行走。

examples.text_en: He felt a strong dizziness in the morning.
examples.text_zh: 他早上感到一阵强烈的晕眩。

examples.text_en: The car raced down a dizzying mountain road.
examples.text_zh: 汽车沿着令人头晕的山路疾驰而下。

examples.text_en: Prices rose at a dizzying speed last year.
examples.text_zh: 去年物价以令人目眩的速度上涨。

examples.text_en: The docile girl did not make a sound.
examples.text_zh: 这个温顺的女孩没有发出一点声音。

examples.text_en: They have a docile dog at home.
examples.text_zh: 他们家养了一只温顺的狗。

examples.text_en: The doctrinaire man would not change his mind.
examples.text_zh: 这个教条主义者不愿改变自己的想法。

examples.text_en: They call him a doctrinaire in the group.
examples.text_zh: 这群人里的人都称他为空论家。

examples.text_en: The church teaches a strict doctrine of love.
examples.text_zh: 这个教会宣扬一种严格的仁爱教义。

examples.text_en: He questioned the main doctrine of the school.
examples.text_zh: 他质疑这所学校的主要学说。

examples.text_en: The thin man began to dodder down the path.
examples.text_zh: 那个瘦弱的老人开始沿小路蹒跚而行。

examples.text_en: Weak legs made him dodder across the room.
examples.text_zh: 双腿无力，使他摇摇晃晃地穿过房间。

examples.text_en: He had to doff his hat in the church.
examples.text_zh: 在教堂里他不得不摘下帽子。

examples.text_en: Guests should doff their shoes before they enter.
examples.text_zh: 客人进屋前应当脱鞋。

examples.text_en: He wrote a funny doggerel for the party.
examples.text_zh: 他为聚会写了一首滑稽的打油诗。

examples.text_en: The book was full of simple, cheerful doggerel.
examples.text_zh: 这本书里全是简单欢快的打油诗。

examples.text_en: We keep doggo in the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 我们躲在那间昏暗的房间里不出声。

examples.text_en: The group will stay doggo for a time.
examples.text_zh: 这群人会躲藏一段时间。

examples.text_en: He refused to accept the dogma without question.
examples.text_zh: 他拒绝不加质疑地接受这一教条。

examples.text_en: Such rigid dogma leaves little room for doubt.
examples.text_zh: 这样僵化的教条几乎没有留下怀疑的余地。

examples.text_en: The dogmatic man would not hear other words.
examples.text_zh: 这个武断的人听不进别的意见。

examples.text_en: His dogmatic way can make a talk hard.
examples.text_zh: 他教条的态度会让谈话变得艰难。

examples.text_en: His dogmatism made any discussion almost impossible.
examples.text_zh: 他的教条主义几乎让任何讨论都无法进行。

examples.text_en: We should avoid dogmatism and listen to others.
examples.text_zh: 我们应当避免教条主义，多听听别人的意见。

examples.text_en: He was in the doldrums after the loss.
examples.text_zh: 失利之后他情绪低落。

examples.text_en: The group was in the doldrums for a long time.
examples.text_zh: 这群人消沉了很长一段时间。

examples.text_en: They live on the dole after the loss of work.
examples.text_zh: 失去工作后他们靠失业救济金生活。

examples.text_en: The dole was a small amount each week.
examples.text_zh: 这份救济金每周数额很小。

examples.text_en: The doleful song was hard to hear.
examples.text_zh: 这首悲哀的歌令人不忍聆听。

examples.text_en: She had a doleful look on her face.
examples.text_zh: 她脸上带着忧郁的神情。

examples.text_en: A dolorous song filled the quiet evening air.
examples.text_zh: 一首忧伤的歌回荡在安静的夜空里。

examples.text_en: She sang a dolorous tune about lost love.
examples.text_zh: 她唱了一首关于失去之爱的忧伤曲调。

examples.text_en: They call him a dolt at the school.
examples.text_zh: 学校里的人都叫他笨蛋。

examples.text_en: The dolt did not understand the simple plan.
examples.text_zh: 这个呆子没弄懂这个简单的计划。

examples.text_en: Music is her domain, and she works hard.
examples.text_zh: 音乐是她的领域，她为此很努力。

examples.text_en: This land was once part of the king's domain.
examples.text_zh: 这片土地曾是国王领地的一部分。

examples.text_en: They talk about domestic problems in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论镇上的家庭问题。

examples.text_en: The domestic dog was a friend to the family.
examples.text_zh: 这只家养的狗是全家人的朋友。

examples.text_en: They will domesticate the dog for the home.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把这只狗驯养为家犬。

examples.text_en: We can domesticate a dog with a kind word.
examples.text_zh: 用温和的话语就能把狗驯化。

examples.text_en: His domicile was a small house near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他的住所是海边的一座小房子。

examples.text_en: They have no domicile and no home.
examples.text_zh: 他们没有住所，也没有家。

examples.text_en: She soon became the dominant voice in the group.
examples.text_zh: 她很快成为这个团体中占主导的声音。

examples.text_en: One team was dominant from the very first minute.
examples.text_zh: 其中一支队伍从第一分钟起就占据优势。

examples.text_en: The king held dominion over a vast land.
examples.text_zh: 国王统治着一片辽阔的土地。

examples.text_en: They lost dominion of the small island.
examples.text_zh: 他们失去了对这座小岛的统治权。

examples.text_en: She likes to doodle in the corner of her notes.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢在笔记的角落里涂鸦。

examples.text_en: The child began to doodle on the clean paper.
examples.text_zh: 孩子开始在干净的纸上乱画。

examples.text_en: The seeds stay in dormancy through the cold winter.
examples.text_zh: 这些种子在整个寒冬里保持休眠。

examples.text_en: The volcano woke from a long period of dormancy.
examples.text_zh: 这座火山在长时间的休眠后苏醒过来。

examples.text_en: The dorsal part of the body was in pain.
examples.text_zh: 身体的背部在疼痛。

examples.text_en: They found a small mark on the dorsal side.
examples.text_zh: 他们在背侧发现了一个小痕迹。

examples.text_en: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
examples.text_zh: 医生给他服了一小剂药。

examples.text_en: Take one dose of this syrup each morning.
examples.text_zh: 每天早上服用一剂这种糖浆。

examples.text_en: The dossier on the case was very long.
examples.text_zh: 这个案子的卷宗非常厚。

examples.text_en: They keep a dossier for each person in the office.
examples.text_zh: 他们为办公室里的每个人都存有档案。

examples.text_en: In his dotage he often forgot simple names.
examples.text_zh: 他年老糊涂，常常忘记简单的名字。

examples.text_en: The kind man spent his dotage in a quiet village.
examples.text_zh: 这位善良的老人在这座安静的村庄里安度晚年。

examples.text_en: She will dote on her young son.
examples.text_zh: 她会十分溺爱自己的小儿子。

examples.text_en: They dote on the small child all day.
examples.text_zh: 他们整天都溺爱着这个小孩。

examples.text_en: The doting mother was always near her son.
examples.text_zh: 这位溺爱孩子的母亲总是守在儿子身边。

examples.text_en: They are doting parents to the small child.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这个小孩十分溺爱。

examples.text_en: He will double-cross his own team.
examples.text_zh: 他会出卖自己的队伍。

examples.text_en: They double-cross their friend for the money.
examples.text_zh: 他们为了钱出卖了自己的朋友。

examples.text_en: She will doubtless agree to our simple plan.
examples.text_zh: 她无疑会同意我们简单的计划。

examples.text_en: He is doubtless the best person for the task.
examples.text_zh: 他无疑是做这项工作的最佳人选。

examples.text_en: The dour man did not say a word.
examples.text_zh: 这个阴沉的人一句话也没说。

examples.text_en: She had a dour look on her face.
examples.text_zh: 她脸上带着严厉的神情。

examples.text_en: They will douse the fire with the water.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用水把火浇灭。

examples.text_en: He can douse the light before the night.
examples.text_zh: 他可以在天黑前把灯熄掉。

examples.text_en: The dowdy house had no art on the wall.
examples.text_zh: 这栋过时的房子墙上没有任何艺术品。

examples.text_en: She was dowdy and out of date.
examples.text_zh: 她衣着过时，显得懒散。

examples.text_en: We need down-to-earth words about the work.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要关于这项工作的务实之言。

examples.text_en: His down-to-earth way was a help to all.
examples.text_zh: 他务实的作风对大家都有帮助。

examples.text_en: He looked downcast after losing the final match.
examples.text_zh: 输掉决赛后，他显得很沮丧。

examples.text_en: She felt downcast and said very little.
examples.text_zh: 她感到沮丧，几乎没说什么话。

examples.text_en: The manager tried to downplay the small mistake.
examples.text_zh: 经理试图淡化这个小错误。

examples.text_en: They downplay the risks of the new drug.
examples.text_zh: 他们不重视这种新药的风险。

examples.text_en: The downturn in the value of gold was clear.
examples.text_zh: 黄金价值的下跌趋势很明显。

examples.text_en: There was a downturn in the company last year.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司去年出现了衰退。

examples.text_en: The road was on a downward line.
examples.text_zh: 这条路呈向下的走势。

examples.text_en: They watch the downward change in the value.
examples.text_zh: 他们注视着价值的下降变化。

examples.text_en: The dowry was a great help to the young family.
examples.text_zh: 这份嫁妆对这个年轻家庭帮助很大。

examples.text_en: They will give a large dowry for their daughter.
examples.text_zh: 他们会为女儿准备丰厚的嫁妆。

examples.text_en: He is the doyen of local nature writers.
examples.text_zh: 他是当地自然文学作家中的老前辈。

examples.text_en: The doyen gave a short talk to the young staff.
examples.text_zh: 这位老前辈给年轻员工做了简短的讲话。

examples.text_en: The room was drab and needed some warm colors.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间很单调，需要一些暖色。

examples.text_en: She wore a drab brown coat all winter.
examples.text_zh: 整个冬天她都穿着一件单调的棕色外套。

examples.text_en: The draconian law was a problem for many people.
examples.text_zh: 这条严苛的法律对许多人来说都是个问题。

examples.text_en: They call the new rules draconian and hard.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这些新规定既严酷又无情。

examples.text_en: His draftsmanship was clear and very fine.
examples.text_zh: 他的制图清晰而精美。

examples.text_en: The draftsmanship of the plan was a great help.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划的制图帮了大忙。

examples.text_en: The field needs better drainage before the rain.
examples.text_zh: 这块地在雨季前需要更好的排水。

examples.text_en: Poor drainage caused water to fill the yard.
examples.text_zh: 排水不良使院子里积满了水。

examples.text_en: The change in the town was very dramatic.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇的变化非常戏剧性。

examples.text_en: It was a dramatic end to the long story.
examples.text_zh: 这个漫长故事的结局颇具戏剧性。

examples.text_en: The value of gold can change dramatically.
examples.text_zh: 黄金的价值可能发生剧烈变化。

examples.text_en: The town can change dramatically in a short time.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇能在短时间内发生巨大变化。

examples.text_en: They plan to dramatize that story for television.
examples.text_zh: 他们打算把那个故事改编成电视剧。

examples.text_en: The writer will dramatize her novel for the stage.
examples.text_zh: 这位作家将把自己的小说改编成舞台剧。

examples.text_en: The castle drawbridge was raised at night.
examples.text_zh: 城堡的吊桥在夜里升了起来。

examples.text_en: They crossed the drawbridge to enter the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们走过吊桥进入镇子。

examples.text_en: He began to drawl his answer in a lazy way.
examples.text_zh: 他懒洋洋地拖长声音回答。

examples.text_en: She would drawl every word to annoy her brother.
examples.text_zh: 她故意拖长每个字的音来惹她哥哥生气。

examples.text_en: The show was dreadfully long and rather dull.
examples.text_zh: 这场演出长得要命，而且相当乏味。

examples.text_en: He felt dreadfully tired after the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 长途旅行后他感到非常疲惫。

examples.text_en: The rainy day felt long and dreary.
examples.text_zh: 这个雨天显得漫长而沉闷。

examples.text_en: He found the work dreary and without any joy.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得这份工作乏味，毫无乐趣。

examples.text_en: The dregs of the water were in the cup.
examples.text_zh: 杯子里是水的沉渣。

examples.text_en: They left the dregs of the food in the box.
examples.text_zh: 他们把食物的残渣留在了盒子里。

examples.text_en: A sudden shower can drench you in seconds.
examples.text_zh: 一场突如其来的阵雨几秒钟就能把你淋透。

examples.text_en: The heavy rain will drench the dry fields.
examples.text_zh: 大雨会把干涸的田地淋透。

examples.text_en: The baby began to dribble onto the clean cloth.
examples.text_zh: 婴儿开始把口水流到干净的布上。

examples.text_en: Water will dribble slowly from that thin pipe.
examples.text_zh: 水会从那根细管里慢慢滴下来。

examples.text_en: The drier was a great help in the room.
examples.text_zh: 这台干燥机在房间里帮了大忙。

examples.text_en: They need a drier for the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们需要一台干燥机来处理食物。

examples.text_en: We found driftwood along the quiet sandy beach.
examples.text_zh: 我们在安静的沙滩上找到了浮木。

examples.text_en: He built a small fire with dry driftwood.
examples.text_zh: 他用干燥的浮木生了一小堆火。

examples.text_en: The cave roof was covered with pale dripstone.
examples.text_zh: 洞顶覆盖着苍白的滴水石。

examples.text_en: Water slowly formed the dripstone in the cave.
examples.text_zh: 水慢慢地在洞里形成了滴水石。

examples.text_en: He would drivel on about his great plans.
examples.text_zh: 他总是没完没了地胡扯自己了不起的计划。

examples.text_en: They drivel about money all day long.
examples.text_zh: 他们整天唠叨着钱的事，尽是些废话。

examples.text_en: It was a cold, drizzly morning in the city.
examples.text_zh: 这是城里一个寒冷而细雨绵绵的早晨。

examples.text_en: The drizzly weather kept the children inside.
examples.text_zh: 细雨绵绵的天气让孩子们待在屋里。

examples.text_en: The droll story was very fine.
examples.text_zh: 这个滑稽的故事非常有趣。

examples.text_en: He had a droll way with the young children.
examples.text_zh: 他逗孩子的方式很滑稽。

examples.text_en: His drollery can make the room happy.
examples.text_zh: 他的玩笑能让整个房间都欢快起来。

examples.text_en: The drollery was a fine part of the show.
examples.text_zh: 这段玩笑是演出中精彩的一部分。

examples.text_en: A small drone flew over the green field.
examples.text_zh: 一架小无人机飞过绿色的田野。

examples.text_en: The drone of the plane kept us awake.
examples.text_zh: 飞机的嗡嗡声让我们睡不着。

examples.text_en: There was a drop-off in the value of gold.
examples.text_zh: 黄金的价值出现了下降。

examples.text_en: The drop-off in the water was a problem.
examples.text_zh: 水量的减少是个问题。

examples.text_en: A drop-out can lose part of the data.
examples.text_zh: 漏失会造成一部分数据的丢失。

examples.text_en: The drop-out of data was the problem.
examples.text_zh: 数据的漏失正是问题所在。

examples.text_en: A small droplet was on the green land.
examples.text_zh: 一滴小小的水珠落在绿地上。

examples.text_en: Each droplet of water was clear and fine.
examples.text_zh: 每一滴水珠都清澈而美好。

examples.text_en: The school helps every dropout find a new path.
examples.text_zh: 学校帮助每个退学者找到新出路。

examples.text_en: He was a dropout and later became a writer.
examples.text_zh: 他曾是退学学生，后来成了作家。

examples.text_en: The metal worker skimmed the dross off the top.
examples.text_zh: 金属工人撇去了表面的浮渣。

examples.text_en: He treated their kind words as mere dross.
examples.text_zh: 他把他们的好话当作无用的渣滓。
